title: Proof workspace
guidance: Reduce the footprint of add-proof and saved-proof surfaces. Consider one workspace with a compact add affordance. Remove obvious helper/reminder copy and Newest first. Retain the improved icon-and-copy empty state, with clear hierarchy.

Latest human direction: Add proof opens a separate modal prompt over dim/blurred content instead of expanding inline and shifting saved rows. Use compact empty-state spacing and align icon with first copy line. Preserve draft, validation, pending dismissal/reopen, result focus and uncertainty guards.

decisions.title: One compact workspace
decisions.reason: Add proof reveals the URL form above the saved list in one container. Do not retain separate form/list cards or force a modal for one field.

decisions.title: Minimal entry and honest draft recovery
decisions.reason: Delivery link, validation and Save are enough. Remove intro/help/repeated Proof labels, Newest first and the saving-does-not-complete reminder. Unknown/rejected drafts remain visible until explicit recovery.

decisions.title: Readable empty state
decisions.reason: Keep a quiet icon and short no-proof message. Narrow enlarged text stacks the capped48px artwork and gives copy the full card width.

decisions.title: 1.8 separate proof prompt
decisions.reason: Add proof opens a native top-layer modal without moving saved rows. Draft and mutation owner remain in the story. X/Escape/backdrop dismisses presentation, preserves draft and does not cancel dispatched work. Overflow opens at visible title; explicit input editing scrolls focused input into view. Empty icon aligns with first copy line and uses compact vertical space.

parameters.name: Workspace
parameters.description: Maximum52rem; compact title/count/add row; inline form divider; rows use1.25rem vertical rhythm; native submit supports Enter.

parameters.name: State ownership
parameters.description: A01 compact closed entry; A02/A05/B01 open form; confirmed rows remain visible. Save timeout becomes B03 and requires a read before retry.

parameters.name: Reconciliation and feedback
parameters.description: B04 keeps the retained form visible. A06 success feedback is emitted only after a confirmed save/found proof, not a status read.

parameters.name: Enlarged narrow spacing
parameters.description: Workspace padding min(1.125rem,4.5vw), action inline padding min(.875em,16px), preserving explicit text enlargement.
